screens.name: editor-extension
setup: Action 'prepare: series/programming-languages/episodes/02-c-advanced-features' (copy to C:\lab\pl02, dotnet build), then 'screen-prepare: series/programming-languages/episodes/02-c-advanced-features/editor-extension': VS Code opens C:\lab\pl02 with Program.cs at line 28
If the Workspace Trust dialog appears: click 'Yes, I trust the authors'

The window opens with only the C# extension and its .NET runtime helper enabled (vscode.extensions keep-list; C# Dev Kit and everything else stay off for this window). Wait until the status bar shows '{} C#' and a hover answers; clear the notification 'Required assets to build and debug are missing ... Add them?' with its X (bell icon, bottom right) without adding anything
Rehearse one hover on TotalBudget off camera so the first tooltip is not slow; park the pointer on the empty part of the Explorer
Record with 'screen-play: .../editor-extension' just before window.go: the pointer script then performs the hovers below by itself and ends the take
steps: Hover 'TotalBudget' inside the braces '{requests.TotalBudget}' on line 28 (the second TotalBudget on the line; the first is plain string text); keep still about 4 seconds while the tooltip shows
Move to 'HighPriority' inside '{requests.HighPriority.Count()}' on line 29; about 4 seconds
Move to 'Today' inside '{clock.Today:yyyy-MM-dd}' on line 30; about 4 seconds
Move the pointer off the window; create recordings\stop
After the take: click the window's close button (X) before 'teardown:' removes C:\lab\pl02

(no doc comment); (3) 'DateOnly TimeProviderExtensions.extension(TimeProvider).Today { get; }' and 'time.Today: an extension property on a framework type.'. Each tooltip opens above its line.
